target.title: feat(ios): resume chat from the afterSeq cursor on reconnect
target.body:
**Stacked PR**: based on the gateway branch `feat/gateway-chat-history-after-seq` (#100267) and must land after it.

Part of #100197

## What Problem This Solves

When the iOS app reconnects (foreground resume, or a detected event seq gap), it refetches the entire chat history and wholesale-replaces the timeline. On long sessions this is slow, wasteful, and can visibly churn the transcript when only a handful of messages were missed.

## Why This Change Was Made

The gateway now supports an `afterSeq` catch-up cursor on `chat.history` (#100267). This PR adopts it in the shared chat pipeline: the view model tracks the highest applied transcript seq (`__openclaw.seq`), and reconnect paths fetch only the missed delta, looping `nextAfterSeq`/`hasMore` and appending through the existing reconciliation/dedup path. Delta pages are re-anchored into transcript-seq order because the gap-triggering newer push is delivered before the async delta returns. Version skew is a named contract: if the response lacks the `afterSeq` echo, the gateway ignored the cursor and the client falls back to today's full-replace path — same for fresh sessions with no tracked seq. Also fixes a latent bug where a seq gap drained pending runs but left stale streaming assistant text on screen. The post-send refresh ladder is deliberately untouched (its rungs also cover missed chat-final events); retiring rungs is a follow-up once the cursor proves out.

## User Impact

Reconnects after backgrounding or transport gaps fetch only missed messages instead of the full transcript: faster catch-up, less data, no timeline churn, and no more stale "streaming" bubble after a connection gap. Older gateways keep the exact current behavior.

## Evidence

- New `ChatHistoryAfterSeqTests` (7 tests): delta append without duplicates, multi-page cursor loop, push-before-delta ordering race, legacy full-page fallback, fresh-session full fetch, seq-gap streaming-text cleanup, foreground delta fetch.
- `swift build` + `swift test --filter ChatViewModelTests` (105/105) green in `apps/shared/OpenClawKit`, post-rebase onto the final gateway head.
- Flake diligence: the one timing flake seen also reproduces on the pure base branch (2/8 runs) with the identical failure — pre-existing parallel-load flake, tracked separately.
- Contract verified against `packages/gateway-protocol/src/schema/logs-chat.ts` and `src/gateway/server-methods/chat.ts` on the base branch, including `attachOpenClawTranscriptMeta` seq stamping on pushed rows.
- Codex autoreview: one accepted P1 (delta appended after newer pushed rows could misorder the transcript) fixed with a regression test; final branch review clean ("patch is correct").

Known gaps: no full iOS `xcodebuild` in this environment (the app-target diff is a 12-line mirror of an adjacent compiling method; CI covers it); macOS WebChat transport intentionally stays on the legacy full-page default (identical to today) — follow-up can add its override.
